name: Pest and termite treatment
summary: How tenants and owners handle pest and termite treatment in Singapore — cockroach/ant programmes, termite inspections, landlord vs tenant scope, and condo common-area boundaries.
body:
Tropical housing brings cockroaches, ants, mosquitoes, and subterranean termites. One-off sprays rarely beat breeding cycles; serious termite finds need inspection, baiting or dusting, and follow-up.

## Typical jobs
- Kitchen/bathroom cockroach programmes
- Ant and bed-bug treatments
- Mosquito breeding-site advice
- Termite inspection and monitoring stations
- Landlord / MCST coordination for shared stacks

Photos and tenancy clauses matter before arguing who pays.

## How to choose
Prefer firms that explain active ingredients, re-entry times, and pet safety. Ask whether the quote is a single spray or a multi-visit programme. For termites, insist on a written inspection diagram — not only a verbal “maybe.”

## Practical tip
Declutter under sinks and seal food before the first visit. Treatment fails when bait stations sit next to competing crumbs.
